data: What is the approximate lowest value of the blue line in the middle figure at 500 samples?

The blue line represents the human evaluation. The middle figure corresponds to the second subfigure in the compound figure, which shows the results for seq2seq on CNN/Daily Mail using Edit. At approximately 500 samples, the blue line (representing human evaluation) has an approximate lowest value of around 0.07.
